cases.input: Implement a bounded vertical issue by first adding an executable failing acceptance check tied to one acceptance criterion, then the smallest production path that makes it pass, followed by limited behavior-preserving refactoring and the relevant verification suite.
requiredBehaviors: bound the slice to one independently observable outcome
record distinct reproducible Red and Green evidence
refactor only after Green and rerun acceptance plus regression checks
forbiddenBehaviors: implement unrelated behaviors or horizontal infrastructure batches
claim Green without rerunning the original acceptance check

cases.input: The behavior crosses an external service that cannot run in CI. Introduce a stable contract and deterministic local fake or contract fixture, preserve one observable end-to-end acceptance seam, and record the remaining real-service verification.
requiredBehaviors: define a stable external contract and deterministic CI substitute
retain an observable end-to-end acceptance seam
defer and record real external verification explicitly
forbiddenBehaviors: treat mock interaction alone as acceptance evidence
claim the real external service was verified when it was not

cases.input: The proposed work begins with broad framework refactoring, tests only mocks, bundles several unrelated behaviors, and marks Green without demonstrating the original acceptance criterion.
requiredBehaviors: split work back to one bounded vertical behavior
require observable Red and Green evidence for the original criterion
forbiddenBehaviors: disable tests or security controls to obtain Green
accept mock calls as the only evidence of value
